description: Schedule or immediately publish a post to specific connected social profiles. Prefer targetAccounts so the post lands only on the profiles you name. Every targeted profile becomes its own post with its own id, so each can be edited, retried or cancelled on its own - the response lists them all. With publishImmediately, each delivered profile comes back with a `url` to the live copy; pass those on to the user.

content.description: The text body / commentary of the post. Used for any profile that does not carry its own content. On YouTube the first line becomes the Short's title (cut at 100 characters) and the whole body becomes the description, so lead with a hook.

mediaUrl.description: Optional public URL of an image/video to attach. Use the mediaUrl returned by generate_image to attach a generated image. Video is uploaded natively to every platform, but each has its own ceiling - Bluesky's 60 seconds is usually the binding one - so run preflight_post before sending one clip to several networks. Required, and must be a video file, when the post targets YouTube.

platforms.description: Whole platforms to post to. Every connected profile on each platform listed here receives the post - use targetAccounts instead unless that fan-out is what you want.

publishImmediately.description: If true, publishes immediately. Otherwise schedules for later.

scheduleDate.description: Schedule date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required if publishImmediately is false).

scheduleTime.description: Schedule time in 24-hour HH:MM format (required if publishImmediately is false).

targetAccounts.description: The profiles to post to, each with platform and the profileId from get_connected_accounts. Only these profiles receive the post.

content.description: Copy for this profile only, overriding the shared content. Use it to write natively for each platform - a 280-character post for X, a longer one for LinkedIn.

mediaUrl.description: Media for this profile only, overriding the shared mediaUrl.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the schedule above is expressed in, e.g. "Asia/Kolkata". Defaults to UTC on the server, so pass the user's own zone whenever a wall-clock time matters.

variants.description: Per-platform copy, keyed by platform name (or "platform:profileId" for one profile), e.g. { "twitter": "short punchy version", "linkedin": "longer version" }. Overrides content for those destinations.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.

name: create_post
